title: Water safety awareness
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 1 Creative Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Talk about water points the children have at home. A montage: pictures of water points cut out and pasted together.

skills.key_step: The child names water points around the home and their dangers.

floor.question: Who do you call when you are hurt?

board.do: A baby or a small child.

misconceptions.ask: Can a baby be in danger near a bucket of water?
misconceptions.repair: Talk about why a baby must never be left near a bucket.

misconceptions.ask: Is a drum full of water at home a water point?
misconceptions.repair: Count all the places water is kept at home.

misconceptions.ask: Water is spilt on the kitchen floor. What is the danger?
misconceptions.repair: Walk carefully on a wet floor in role play.

listen_for: yes, I can see the water
misconceptions.ask: Is an open well safe to play near?
misconceptions.repair: Look at a picture of a covered and an open well.

checks.question: Name a water point at home.
checks.answer: any of: a tap, a tank, a drum, a basin, a well

checks.question: Why is a wet floor dangerous?

skills.key_step: The child names ways to keep safe around water at home: an adult near, covers on, basins emptied, walk on wet floors, call an adult.

floor.question: Name a water point in your home.
floor.answer: any of: a tap, a tank, a drum, a basin

representations: a covered and an uncovered container
steps: Play in water only with an adult.
Call an adult if a little child goes near water.

board.do: Wait for: put the lid on.

misconceptions.ask: Can a small child play in water without an adult?
misconceptions.repair: Role play asking an adult before water play.

misconceptions.ask: You take water from the drum. What do you do after?
misconceptions.repair: Ask: who could fall in or what could get in?

misconceptions.ask: The bathroom floor is wet. How do you walk?
misconceptions.repair: Watch a toy slide on a wet tray.

misconceptions.ask: Your baby brother crawls to a basin of water. What do you do?

checks.question: Can a small child play in water alone?
What do you do after taking water from a drum?
